description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Band', which is a part of a PHP library for rendering graph plots, specifically implementing a band (area chart with min and max) visualization. It includes methods for drawing the legend sample and rendering the plot with upper and lower bands, utilizing a canvas object for drawing operations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Band
classes.description: Defines a band plot class that extends Image_Graph_Plot to render area charts with min and max bounds, including methods for drawing legend samples and plotting the data bands.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the band chart for the legend, using a polygon shape to visually indicate the plot style.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the band plot on the canvas by processing dataset's high and low bounds, constructing upper and lower bands, and drawing a filled polygon for each dataset.
